import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('products/services/catalogue-one-command-qa')
receipt=base/'runner-corrected-smoke.json'
data=json.loads(receipt.read_text())
assert data['clean']['exit_code']==0 and data['duplicate']['exit_code']==2
assert 'style SH-100: same image URL used twice' in data['duplicate']['stderr']
summary, verification=data['clean']['stdout'].split('\n',1)
checks=json.loads(verification)['checks']
assert len(checks)==12 and all(checks.values())
assert data['trial']['required_runtime_files']==7 and data['trial']['commands_after_placement']==1
sources=[]
for name, source in sorted(data['provenance'].items()):
    path=Path(source['path'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==source['sha256'], path
    sources.append(f'- `{name}` from `{path}` · SHA-256 `{source["sha256"]}`')
demo=base/'operator-demo-en-fr.md'
if demo.exists():
    print('Existing demo preserved')
else:
    demo.write_text('''# Catalogue QA worked example / Exemple de contrôle du catalogue
